d: As seat-sharing talks between the Congress and Samajwadi Party ahead of the Uttar Pradesh elections come into focus, Congress MP Imran Masood has questioned the SP's approach. Citing Rahul Gandhi's contribution to the INDIA bloc's 2024 Lok Sabha performance, Masood said Congress had also helped secure victories and questioned why his party must always show generosity. He also warned that offering zero seats would naturally result in zero victories. Watch
